item.text: [{"task_id":"4522001f","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    color = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    scale = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    block = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    count = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    unit = int(round(params['rule'][6]))","    h, w = grid.shape","    out = np.full((h * scale, w * scale), bg, dtype=int)","    occupied = np.argwhere(grid != bg)","    marked = np.argwhere(grid == marker)","    if len(occupied) == 0 or len(marked) == 0:","        return out","    top = int(np.min(occupied[:, 0]))","    left = int(np.min(occupied[:, 1]))","    mr = int(marked[0, 0]) - top","    mc = int(marked[0, 1]) - left","    for k in range(count):","        r = top + k * block","        if mr == mc:","            c = left + k * block","        else:","            c = left + (count - unit - k) * block","        out[r:r + block, c:c + block] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[7]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,3,3,4,2,1]},"rationale":"The occupied 2x2 block becomes two green 4x4 squares within a threefold enlarged canvas. Its original top and left margins remain unchanged. The red corner selects the diagonal: matching relative coordinates select the main diagonal; otherwise select the opposite diagonal."}]
